retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1970s aesthetic featuring a musician in a yellow shirt against a black void, paired with heavy, swash-heavy psychedelic serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic, low-key portrait of a musician playing an electric guitar, characterized by a stark black background and vibrant yellow lighting. The composition is balanced by large-scale, decorative typography in the upper right quadrant that utilizes extreme swashes and a warm color scheme of yellow and red.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned left-of-center with typography filling the right-side negative space
Color harmony between the subject's yellow shirt and the primary display text
Contrast between the sharp, dark sunglasses of the subject and the fluid, organic curves of the lettering
Diagonal line created by the guitar neck leading the eye toward the text block
coreInvariants: High-saturation yellow as the primary light source and text color
Heavyweight serif font with exaggerated decorative swashes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician occupies the left half of the frame from the waist up, scaled to approximately 70% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The musician's face and sunglasses serve as the primary anchor, with the guitar body acting as a secondary base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, follows the guitar neck upward and rightward into the large display typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the subject and text, creating a stage-lighting effect.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value and high saturation for foreground elements against zero-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to black, yellow, and red for a classic 70s soul aesthetic.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast Didone or Fat Face serif
letterConstructionRules: Extreme weight contrast between thick and thin strokes
Exaggerated ball terminals and teardrop swashes
Interlocking or overlapping characters where swashes permit
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature extended tails that underline adjacent characters
O and J characters utilize circular, swirling flourishes

composition.relationshipToImage: Balances the subject on the left

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Highly decorative display face paired with a simpler, functional slab serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the iconic 70s decorative curves and weight.
Provides the necessary weight and retro feel, though less contrasty.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key photograph of a male musician with dark hair and sunglasses, wearing a bright yellow shirt and dark vest, playing a sunburst electric hollow-body guitar. The background must be solid black with dramatic side-lighting hitting the subject.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large-scale decorative serif typography in the upper right corner in bright yellow. Use a secondary line of text in smaller red slab-serif font. Ensure the yellow text has exaggerated swashes that interlock.

verificationChecks: Does the main text feature extreme swashes and ball terminals?
Is the color palette strictly yellow, red, and black?
Is the subject's shirt a high-saturation yellow?

adjustableVariables: Scale of the guitar in the frame
Specific hue of the red accent text
mustRedesign: Do not use clean, modern sans-serifs
Ensure the lighting does not spill into the background

avoid: Default font settings without kerning adjustments

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast shadows on the subject's face.
Verify that the yellow of the shirt matches the yellow of the text.
Ensure the swashes do not obscure the legibility of the main title.
Confirm the background is void of any detail or texture.
Check that the red text provides a clear hierarchical break.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Musician) + Lighting(High-Contrast Yellow) + Background(Solid Black) + Typography(Psychedelic Swash Serif) = 1970s Soul Aesthetic
